decision.summary: A coherent 3D discontinuity begins ~594–596: N and E jump up, U drops sharply. N remains elevated through 603 with no return; E declines partially but does not rejoin pre-event trend; U recovers slowly but remains offset. No full return observed in allowed context [555,639], so all candidate temporary offsets are uncertain. No evidence of smooth motion or isolated spikes—edges are multi-sample and correlated across axes.

intervals.observation: N: sharp multi-sample rise ~594–597 (+~12 MAD), sustained elevated level through 603; E: rise ~595–598 (+~5 MAD) followed by gradual decline but not back to pre-event level by 603; U: sharp drop ~594–596 (−~15 MAD) with slow partial recovery, still far below pre-event by 603. Return not observed on any axis within allowed context; E and U show incomplete recovery, N shows no return. Thus, temporary offset status is uncertain.
